stations.title: Radio
stations.text: Two numbers read out, easy to swap.

captions: A night search, and Rhona passes positions on the radio as grid references.
Today the two numbers travel loose, and a team once went east for north.
You keep each pair together in a tuple and take it apart by name.
Now the moved position goes out east first, and the team heads the right way.
Tuples, two values from one function, unpacking, and zip.
